## Deploy readiness board (R100, informational)

This check is informational on pull requests during the pre-launch
burn-down. It gates only the codebase-invariant sections (stub values
and prod-switch coherence). The environment-dependent sections (wiring,
env discovery, operator keys) are surfaced below but do not block the
PR because the runner carries no production secrets. The prod-deploy
gate (deploy-readiness-gate) enforces every section under strict mode.


READY FOR AUDIT (operator 116) — growth-project-backend#673 @ 5743e51fb0ee13e7fe95a865a809f05b6108abc2

Piece T3 of the trials split of #656 (3 pieces: #671 -> #672 -> #673). Base `agent115/trials-split-2-editor-notices`. T4 (max-tier rule).
Checks at this head (latest run per check, 11 checks): all green. CodeQL, danger, banned casts and build-sbom run only when the stack lands on main.
Land rule: Land as one (rule 11); inert until T3; deploy after T3, then mobile #338. #672 and #675 both change packages.service/controller: the second to land refreshes.

SIZE ASSESSMENT (operator 116, MODEL_ROUTING 8.2) — growth-project-backend#673 @ 5743e51fb0ee13e7fe95a865a809f05b6108abc2
- Lines: 2556 changed (source 700 / tests 1839 / migrations 0 / docs 17; excluded 0); 11 files. Under the 3,000 hard limit.
- Seams (largest areas): `test/b-trials-3-fix-round.spec.ts` 1055, `test/b-trials-notice-and-webhook.spec.ts` 716, `src/packages/trials` 332, `src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts` 280, `test/b-trials-idempotent-create-compose.spec.ts` 68, `src/checkout/checkout.service.ts` 43.
- Coupling: code piece with its own tests; the piece boundaries, dependency direction (no piece imports a later piece) and per-piece tests are stated in the PR body.
- Decision: KEEP. This is already one logical piece of the owner-ordered split of #656. Cutting it further would separate code from the tests that prove it, and would add a restack round to every later piece without making any line easier to audit. Fix rounds must keep it under 3,000.

FIX ROUND 6 (restack, merge-only) (B-T12-116, agent 116) — growth-project-backend#673 @ 9719cb88f8f0fa1910aa99070f09d5e875bc48a9

Mechanical restack under the `trials` stack lock (taken and released). One merge commit, no content edits, no conflicts.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| none in T3 | merge of #672 @ 4fa2fe4a (fix round 6 of T2, which itself merges #671 @ 1efac91e) into this branch | `9719cb88` | `git diff 5743e51f 9719cb88` equals `git diff e06b5b13 4fa2fe4a` line for line; the T3 specs (`b-trials-notice-and-webhook`, `b-trials-3-fix-round`, `b-trials-idempotent-create-compose`) pass unchanged (139 passed, 3 skipped by the existing composed gate) |

What the merge brings (details in the #671 and #672 FIX ROUND 6 comments): same-purchase concurrent starts own the trial (B-671-1), fresh-clock channel leases and a lease-exhausted guard (B-672-1), cancelled/missing-purchase notices settle `skipped` with a fair keyset retry sweep (B-672-2), the recipient time-zone rule for the trial-end date (Opus B-672-1), and "plus any tax" when Stripe automatic tax is on (C-672-5).

Carried into T3 (operator queue, not part of this restack): the integration with recurring #680's one-trial check (C-656-1); the reconcile-fallback notice has no Stripe subscription to read, so it keeps the line without tax (T3's reconcile test pins that line).

Size: 2,556 changed lines against #672 (unchanged by the restack).

Checks at `9719cb88`: every reported check green on this stacked base (build-and-test [job](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37175137706/job/111356092814)); CodeQL, danger, banned casts and SBOM run only on PRs based on main; H4 deploy readiness skips by design.


_Posted by operator agent 117 from the builder's draft saved at the owner pause (21:04 PDT 10-03); content unchanged except this line and the checks line._

READY FOR AUDIT

FIX ROUND 7 (restack, merge-only) (B-TR-117, agent 117) — growth-project-backend#673 @ 4ebf2a435c8c7f50ee5baa69836b0aac116e7a29

Restack under the `trials` stack lock: merges T2 fix round 7 (`6ce54002` = T1 `c75002c9` + main `b644198b` incl. #675, the #675 conflict resolution in T2, and its composed-behaviour spec) into T3. No content change in this piece.

| Item | Change | Commit | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| T2 moved `4fa2fe4a` -> `6ce54002` | merge commit, no conflicts; no T3 file is touched by the merged delta | `4ebf2a43` | `git diff 6ce54002 4ebf2a43` equals `git diff 4fa2fe4a 9719cb88` byte for byte (11 files, +2,548 / -8) |
| The #675 conflict T3 inherited from main | resolved in T2 (`650c9ea2`), where the packages files live; T3 changes neither file | — | #672 FIX ROUND 7 (failing-before runs [37179924220](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37179924220) and [37179934691](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37179934691), passing-after [37179946404](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37179946404)) |
| T3's own composed gate `test/b-trials-idempotent-create-compose.spec.ts` | its `describeIfComposed` block (skipped while `createIdempotent` was absent from the base) now executes on this tree | — | build-and-test at this head (below); locally 14/14 with T2's new HTTP spec |

Open findings: #673 has no piece verdict yet. The original #656 B findings (Sol B-656-1..7) were closed in #656 fix rounds 4 and 5 (B-656-6, the T3 conflict worker's separate billed-alert receipt, in FIX ROUND 5 `86223987`); nothing unanswered. Carried: C-656-1 (one trial ledger with recurring #680), owed by the trials stack before it lands on a main that has #680; not changed here (see the B-TR-117 report for what T3 needs once #680 lands).

Size: 2,556 changed lines vs T2 (unchanged; under 3,000).

Checks at `4ebf2a43`: every reported check green on this stacked base ([CI run 37179990103](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37179990103): build-and-test 12,682 passed / 245 skipped, the same skipped count as T2, so the three formerly skipped composed-gate tests now run and pass; rls-floor-guard, rls-live-tests, mwb-3-live-tests, community-live-tests; npm audit; Schema parity). CodeQL, danger, banned casts and SBOM run only on PRs based on main; H4 deploy-readiness-gate skips by design.

READY FOR AUDIT

FIX ROUND 8 (B-TR2-117, agent 117) — growth-project-backend#673 @ df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690

Builder: Claude Opus 5.5, job B-TR2-117 (agent 117). This round restacks T3 on T2 fix round 8 ([#672 FIX ROUND 8 @ c5e7ed8e](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5977736892)) and closes Opus C-671-4 in T3, which is the operator default owner ([Opus #671 verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/671#issuecomment-5977434502)). #671 is not moved. Commits on `4ebf2a43`:
- merge commit `45100490`: T2 `c5e7ed8e` into T3; clean, with no T3 file changed;
- tests `df07fabc`;
- fix `df76889f`.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failing-before -> passing-after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Opus C-671-4 (a trial that never started reads "The trial is over") | T1's `purchaseTrialView` assumes `trial_ends_at` is written only when a trial starts, but T3 mirrored `sub.trial_end` on every subscription event. `applyTrialState` now runs the unchanged transition (`trialTransition`). It writes `trial_ends_at` only when this event starts the trial (trialing with access), an earlier write already set it (so later ends are still mirrored), or the ledger says the trial started (`hasStarted`). A lost one-trial race writes none. A never-started attempt keeps `trial_ends_at` null, so it reads `setup_incomplete` while trialing and `none` once cancelled. | `df76889f` | `test/b-trials-notice-and-webhook.spec.ts` "C-671-4 (B-TR2-117) — a trial that never started keeps no trial end: never "The trial is over"", through the real webhook handler and ledger. Control: a started trial keeps its end through the cancel and reads `ended`. 1 red / 68 green in [run 37185687036](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37185687036), green in [run 37185762015](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37185762015). |
| T3 specs on the T2 round 8 rules (no behaviour change in T3) | Four spec changes. (1) The client preference rows in both T3 worlds are stamped (`timezone_updated_at`): the specs mean the client's own LA zone, so the bare "Oct 12" copy holds under the C-672-7 ruling. (2) The purchase mirrors the trial end its event announces, at Stripe's second precision, in "trial_will_end is claimed..." and "trial_will_end after the card was removed..." (B-672-3 checks the notice's end against the purchase's). (3) The "another caller" in both stale-holder tests is a second `TrialNoticeService` replica, because one process never starts a second send of a channel (B-672-4). (4) "a hung push that ignores its abort" advances the 30 s bound plus the 5 s grace and expects the lease held while the push runs. | `df07fabc` | Green in run 37185762015. |

Notes
- Opus's direct C-671-4 view probe calls T1's `purchaseTrialView` with a row that has `trial_ends_at` but never started. It stays red by design, because T1 is not changed (#671 not moved). The fix holds T1's contract at T3's writer, the only place that writes `trial_ends_at`.
- Passing-after lane run 37185762015: `tsc --noEmit` clean; 19 suites, 286/286 tests. These are every `b-trials-*` spec except the live one, the checkout webhook handler, fee split, fan-out hooks and tx plumbing, cancel-pending-on-refund, billing-audit, stripe-webhook, subscription-webhook tier, `email.service`, and Sol's T2 probe file.
- Size: 2,627 changed lines (+2,619/-8) against T2 `c5e7ed8e`, under 3,000. SIZE ASSESSMENT (over 1,500): this is one reviewable unit (trial checkout/webhook lifecycle and its specs); this round adds 71 lines.
- Pre-push checklist: (a) no new logs; (b) the trial-end write sits inside the existing webhook tx update; (c) no new async race (the ledger read is on the same tx); (d) no copy; (e) the failing-before test is above; (f) size is above. Locally, eslint is clean on the changed files and the R75 checker in range mode reports OK.
- Webhook ordering: `trial_will_end` still does not write the purchase's `trial_ends_at`, because an older event must not undo an extension. A notice recorded before `subscription.updated` brings the new end is retired as superseded. The reconciler reopens it once the purchase matches, which the T2 round 8 spec covers.

CI at `df76889f`: every required check is green (build-and-test, schema parity, rls-floor-guard, rls/community/mwb-3 live tests, npm audit, deploy readiness, size-label; deploy-readiness-gate skipping as usual). This is a stacked piece (base T2, not main), so CodeQL, danger, banned casts and SBOM run only on main-based PRs.

Carried, unchanged: C-656-1 #680 integration list (`ops/reports/B-TR-117.md` items 1-6, plus Opus's `reserve()` note), the `customer.subscription.trial_will_end` webhook event and the mobile #338 pairing as landing conditions.

READY FOR AUDIT
